subject: difference between stepwiseqtl makeqtl and fitqtl outputs

messages.author: 10a1608939e8feba
messages.subject: difference between stepwiseqtl makeqtl and fitqtl outputs
parts: HI- I fit a model using stepwiseqtl, which was LOD> 20. I then used makeqtl and fit qtl using the markers derived from stepwiseqtl (because I was unable to plotLodProfile using stepwiseqtl). However, fitqtl using the same markers gives a model with LOD ~1. I don't understand why model building manually should give a different output from the automated model generated by model building. What am i missing? Thanks!

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] difference between stepwiseqtl makeqtl and fitqtl outputs
parts:
The most likely cause would be analyzing a different phenotype. Check your use of the lodcolumn argument.

karl
